description: A React-like component defining the Forecast page of a weather application, including state management, UI rendering, and interaction logic.

classes.name: Forecast
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders the forecast screen, showing hourly/daily weather forecasts with navigation and detail preview.

methods.name: switchMode
methods.description: Switches between 'hourly' and 'daily' forecast modes, restoring previous selection.

methods.name: toggleMode
methods.description: Toggles forecast view mode between hourly and daily.

methods.name: onListChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected list item, updating internal index and detail preview.

methods.name: onListEnter
methods.description: Handles 'Enter' key press on a list item, showing a toast message with forecast info.

methods.name: iconPath
methods.description: Generates the path to an icon asset based on weather condition token.

methods.name: updateDetail
methods.description: Updates the detail panel with information extracted from the selected forecast item.
